result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says no transport compression codec decision is currently recorded, and it names no codec.

The project's memory has nothing on compression. The recorded decisions cover rustls, HTTPS everywhere, verification on all builds, and an LRU cache with a 300-second TTL. I also queried `muninn why`, and it came back "insufficient". The only related material was unrelated one-line session notes (msgpack, cbor, tokio, async-std), none of them a decision about a compression codec.

My first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead.
